segments.text: That's how many it took just to pull the cart carrying one bow.
This was Binaka, the bow of Mahadev himself.
King Janaka of Mithila kept it in an iron chest on eight wheels,
Whoever could string this bow would marry his daughter, Sita.
Kings came from every corner of the land.
Not one of them could even lift it.
Then Sage Vishwamitra arrived with a young prince from Ayodhya,
Ram walked up and lifted the bow as if it weighed nothing.
And as he pulled the string, the bow snapped in half.
Almost everyone in the court fainted.
all the way to someone who was not happy about it.
